name: Santa Fe Relocation
summary: Global relocation firm on many corporate vendor lists — strong when assignment managers need door-to-door household goods plus destination orientation.
body: Santa Fe and peers often appear on corporate approved-vendor lists. Self-movers should still compare Singapore destination-agent quality, storage fees, and Customs GST-relief handling as carefully as origin pack pricing. Confirm who owns the Declaration of Facts timeline relative to your IPA and first-arrival date (used effects generally need to land within six months for relief). Condo lift bookings, packing-waste disposal, and insurance claims processes vary by local partner — get those in writing before the container sails.
